title: Passenger Tales
desc: Travel companion that narrates local history, geology, and nearby stories as you drive — Wikipedia plus AI-generated regional stories in a natural Gemini voice. Mute, skip, replay.

changelog.notes: Settings for story interests (history, geology, nature, and more) and short/medium/long length.
Random Gemini voice option; auto voice preview with on-phone sample cache; remove Test voice button.
Bigger admin-map pins that scale with zoom; lock versions to Aaron's Apps camp mother.
Replace install PNGs with Passenger Tales road icon.
Phase 3 admin OSM map of shared clips.
Make More apps a share-sheet button and drop the home share icon.
